headline: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
summary: Slack's new 'Surfaces' feature allows creating interactive reports and tools directly within chats. AI-powered Slackbot uses conversations and connected apps to gather information. Build dashboards, polls, and presentations without leaving Slack.

headline: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
summary: AI companies are mirroring Big Tech's strategy to push their tech into schools. They claim AI skills are crucial for future jobs and provide learning resources. This approach aims to embed their products early in education.

headline: Amazon’s Fire TV Stick 4K is over half off at under $20
summary: The Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K is on sale for $16.09 with a coupon. This deal offers over 50% off for a limited time. Features include Wi-Fi 6 support and 2GB of memory.

headline: Electric air taxis get the green light for test flights in Texas
summary: Texas is starting test flights for electric and autonomous air taxis. The program launches before final rules are set for the new technology. This is part of a federal initiative to explore advanced air mobility.

headline: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset With Infinite Battery Life Drops to $250
summary: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless headset is now available for $250. It features 'infinite battery life' for continuous wireless gaming. This deal offers a premium gaming headset at a reduced price.

headline: The Retroid Pocket Duo Looks Perfect for DS and 3DS Emulation
summary: The Retroid Pocket Duo is a new Android-powered dual-screen handheld. It's designed specifically for emulating Nintendo DS and 3DS games. This device caters to the growing retro handheld gaming market.

headline: Hasbro Responds to DHS Using AI Optimus Prime in Deportation Posts
summary: Hasbro has responded to the Department of Homeland Security's use of an AI Optimus Prime image. The image was used in social media posts related to deportations. The company's stance on this unauthorized use is now public.

headline: The 34" AOC Agon Pro QD-OLED Gaming Monitor With Massive 4 Year Warranty Drops to $399.99
summary: The AOC Agon Pro 34" QD-OLED gaming monitor is now $399.99. It's highlighted as the least expensive ultra-wide OLED gaming monitor. The monitor comes with an impressive 4-year warranty.

headline: Spies, strategies and missed opportunities: How the lessons of 9/11 are still being learnt
summary: Twenty-five years post-9/11, its lessons continue to shape policy. The attacks defined a generation of foreign, security, and intelligence work. Understanding 9/11's legacy is crucial for current global strategies.

headline: AI boom helps drive surprise UK growth in July
summary: The UK economy grew by 0.4% in July, exceeding expectations. The surprising growth is attributed to the booming AI sector. Analysts had predicted no economic growth for the month.

headline: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
summary: Anthropic reported blocking an attempt to misuse AI for biological weapons. This incident highlights the growing risks of advanced AI models. It reinforces warnings from researchers about AI's potential dangers.

headline: New hurricane season record as 'historic' El Niño leaves Atlantic eerily quiet
summary: The Atlantic hurricane season has reached its peak with no hurricanes formed. A strong, "historic" El Niño is responsible for the unusual quiet. This marks a significant anomaly in hurricane activity.
